description: Search the web: up to 10 results for a query, most relevant first, each with title, URL, publish date, author and the passage of the page that best matches the query. Optional filters: category (news, company, publication, people...), domains to include or exclude, and since (YYYY-MM-DD) for recent pages only. Pair with /web/contents to read the pages. Costs $0.006 USDC on Base via x402.

category.description: Limit to one kind of page

since.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

snippets.description: false leaves out the matching passages (default true)

name: web_search
